perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Cumulative primary evidence still supports Thacker Pass as a strategically relevant domestic lithium build approaching peak construction, backed by DOE/strategic/convertible capital.
No materially newer primary-source development was found in the fresh bounded search, so the prior construction/financing signal remains the defensible frontier rather than manufacturing novelty.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Execution remains construction-to-commissioning conversion; designed 40,000 tpa capacity and financing are not substitutes for realized output, qualification or operating economics.
The next high-value evidence is physical completion/commissioning progress and updated contingency/cost disclosure.
